primary_interest.quote: My understanding is you're looking at voice AI agents for support.

use_case.quote: We figured an AI agent could take some of that load.

edge_framing.quote: With Telnyx, that piece comes as part of the voice agent.

edge_raised_by.quote: For the edge part we were told 50 ms at p95 would be good.

competitors_edge.quote: we were also looking at Cloudflare Workers, to run the logic close to the callers.

competitors_voice.quote: We've got Vonage for the phone lines right now. And we poked at Vapi for the agent side

decision_criteria.quote: I care about that, the time to first token, the round trip. People hang up if it lags.

stated_reason.quote: we'd lean toward keeping things with our existing cloud and AI vendor if we can. Fewer contracts, fewer logins.
